video.description: Source video to insert a scene into.
video.title: Video

start_time.description: Seconds into the source where the generated scene begins.
start_time.title: Start Time

resume_time.description: Seconds into the source where the original footage resumes. Must be after start_time, with footage remaining after it.
resume_time.title: Resume Time

duration.description: Length of the generated scene in seconds (5-13).
duration.title: Duration

prompt.description: What happens in the inserted scene.
examples: A red fox darts across the path and vanishes into the bushes.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_images.description: Reference images guiding the inserted scene (max 9).
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_videos.description: Reference videos guiding the inserted scene (max 3).
reference_videos.title: Reference Videos

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Enhance the prompt using the source video.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

color_match.description: Match the inserted scene's color to the source footage.
color_match.title: Color Match
